mentions.heading: The proposed Separation is contingent upon conditions, may not be completed on timeline, or at all, and may not achieve intended benefits
mentions.detail: Planned spin-off of Electrical Distribution Systems as Versigent; about $178 million separation costs in 2025, incurred even if not completed
mentions.quote: We have incurred, and expect to continue to incur, significant expenses in connection with the Separation, a significant portion of which has already been incurred or will be incurred even if the Separation is not completed, including costs of approximately $178 million during the year ended December 31, 2025.

mentions.heading: Separated companies will be smaller and less diversified
mentions.detail: Post-Separation Aptiv and Versigent smaller, concentrated in industries, lose shared costs and face standalone public-company costs
mentions.quote: As a result, each company could be more vulnerable to global economic trends, geopolitical risks, demand or supply shocks, and changing industry or market conditions, which could have a material adverse effect on its business, financial condition, cash flows and results of operations.

mentions.heading: If distribution of Versigent shares fails to qualify as tax-free, subsidiaries and shareholders could face significant tax liabilities
mentions.detail: Relies on tax opinions under Code Section 355(a)(1); no IRS ruling sought; also intended tax-free for Swiss purposes
mentions.quote: We do not intend to seek a ruling from the Internal Revenue Service (the “IRS”) with respect to the U.S. federal income tax treatment of the Separation.

drivers.name: Section 355(a)(1) of the Internal Revenue Code
